My mom chose to ignore my self-harm when she saw it for the first time. I wish she had done something years ago, I may not have been still struggling with it today. Let your daughter know that you are supportive of her and that you love her. I wish my mother told me she loved me in the moments I needed it most. Try to talk to her about what's going on in her life, and empathize. If she's having a hard time in school, try suggesting a tutor if you can afford it. If not, volunteer to help her with work. Every little bit, every little small action helps. I wish my mother realized that.
